name: ESDS Software Solution Ltd
tagline: Nashik-based cloud/data-centre/GPU-as-a-Service player that listed TODAY (2026-09-04) at a 76% IPO premium — genuinely high margins (~50% EBITDA) and growth (+28% revenue, +117% PAT in FY26) squarely inside the live data-centre/AI theme, but zero public-market track record and an already-rich listing valuation
business_overview: One of only two Indian players claimed to offer the full spectrum of GPU-as-a-Service (GPUaaS), cloud, managed services and data-centre infrastructure plus software, largely serving government/BFSI and enterprise customers (MeitY-empanelled). IPO priced at Rs 429/share, raised ~Rs 720 Cr fresh issue, listed on NSE/BSE 2026-09-04 (the same day as this scan) at a ~76% premium to issue price. No ValuePickr thread exists yet — too new — so this is a web-only, first-listing-day assessment.
fundamentals_table: ~Rs 8,873 Cr — likely materially higher post the ~76% listing-day pop; not yet independently re-confirmed
Rs 120.8 Cr, +117% YoY (FY25: Rs 55.6 Cr; FY24: Rs 13.6 Cr)
~Rs 576 Cr of the IPO proceeds earmarked for cloud-computing/data-centre infrastructure
Customers using all 3 service lines rose from 62.3% (FY24) to 89.0% (FY26) — a real land-and-expand trend
fundamentals_narrative: The FY26 numbers are genuinely excellent for a company of this scale — 28% revenue growth compounding into 117% PAT growth, ~50% EBITDA margins, and a rising cross-sell rate showing real customer stickiness. It sits squarely inside the live priority-1 'data-centre power & cooling' / hyperscale theme (and the 'AI networking' theme's data-centre-infrastructure angle), which is exactly the kind of company this screen is meant to surface. The two honest caveats: (1) it has zero days of public-market or post-IPO-disclosure track record as of this scan, and (2) an ~Rs 8,900 Cr listing-day market cap on Rs 472 Cr FY26 revenue is already ~19x trailing sales and ~73x trailing earnings before the 76% pop is even priced in — a rich starting point that assumes the growth/margin profile is durable.

FY26 financials are genuinely strong: 28% revenue growth, 117% PAT growth, ~50% EBITDA margin, low leverage (D/E 0.08)
